name: Omnifolio
description: Every wallet, one portfolio: lending, Uniswap liquidity and spot balances across chains, read live. Built for DeFi University.

ZERION_API_KEY.description: Reads every EVM protocol and chain through Zerion (free key at dashboard.zerion.io). Leave empty to skip.

ALCHEMY_API_KEY.description: RPC for Uniswap V4 position discovery on Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum and BNB Chain (free key at alchemy.com). Leave empty to use public RPCs (V3 only).

OWNER_WALLETS.description: Make the site yours alone: your wallet addresses separated by commas. Leave empty to keep it open.

DATABASE_URL.description: Postgres for accounts. Leave empty and the post-deploy step creates a Cloud SQL instance for you (about $10 a month); or paste another Postgres connection string.
